text_blocks.snippet: The standard treatment for neurosyphilis is intravenous (IV) penicillin G, administered at a high dose for 10-14 days. Alternative treatments, like ceftriaxone, may be considered in cases of penicillin allergy, but data on their effectiveness is limited. Follow-up care, including cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis, is crucial to assess treatment response and detect potential treatment failures.
